title: Who holds a context
situation: Record corrections, third cold read, 2026-10-13: who holds a context was recorded only with each cut.
decision: A context is held by the architect the operator works with on it, or by a persona over the architect named for it; a cut records its holders. Cratylus's own five contexts are held by the architect.
consequences: A standing record of each context's holder beside its description is future work for the journal.
